02 Master Data
item.description: M11: public lists and admin CRUD (delete only if unused; accommodations are retired when in use).

exec: pm.test('each group has a label and items', () => groups.forEach((g) => { pm.expect(g.label).to.be.a('string'); pm.expect(g.items).to.be.an('array').that.is.not.empty; }));
pm.test('no retired accommodations', () => groups.forEach((g) => g.items.forEach((i) => pm.expect(i.is_retired).to.eql(false))));
pm.test('stored as active in the right group', () => { pm.expect(body.group).to.eql('physical_access'); pm.expect(body.is_retired).to.eql(false); });
